scoring_policy: Scores are evidence-backed current estimates. A category reaches 10 only when every listed exit criterion is verified against the exact release artifact. Commercial defensibility is not scored for the personal build.

categories.name: Product vision and scope
evidence: quality/capabilities.json defines the personal-core promise, primary platform, non-goals, lifecycle model, and ten workflows
docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md is generated from that authority
docs/OMNI_10_OUT_OF_10_PLAN.md defines measurable release gates
exit_criteria: One clear personal-assistant promise
Explicit stable scope and non-goals
Primary and secondary platform claims are bounded
Ten measurable owner workflows are locked
Post-10 ideas are separated from core scope

categories.name: Implementation breadth and depth
evidence: Active implementation inventory is generated by scripts/quality_baseline.py
quality/capabilities.json maps the active capability surface and known gaps
exit_criteria: Every advertised stable capability has a real implementation
Every stable effect has verification
Every stable capability has availability, timeout, cancellation, and failure behavior
Ten core workflows meet repeated success targets

categories.name: Automated testing and continuous verification
evidence: B01 package suite passes: 14 package metadata, runtime-path, content, and isolated artifact-install tests
Latest broad Python run: 668 passed, 33 skipped, 10 failed; one calendar timing failure and nine optional-vision/security failures remain B03 blockers
Frontend clean install, dependency tree, audit, zero-warning lint, and production build pass on Node 22/npm 12
No CI workflow currently exists and the required broad suite is not green
exit_criteria: Required unit, integration, API, E2E, package, platform, offline, and security jobs are green
No required release suite skips
Backend live tests start automatically
Twenty repeated core-suite runs have no flaky failures
Release artifact, migrations, and recovery are tested

categories.name: User experience and accessibility
evidence: Next.js UI builds and has broad presentation features
First-run, degraded-state, recovery, accessibility, and daily workflow behavior are not release-qualified
exit_criteria: Fresh setup is guided and repeatable
Connection, model, microphone, offline, remote, and action states are always visible
Long actions cancel, time out, and recover
WCAG-oriented automated and manual checks pass
Core workflows are measurably more useful than manual execution

categories.name: Feature authenticity and truthful effects
evidence: Successful mock fallback exists in frontend/backend execution
Integration plugins return canned demo success
Voice cloning is a metadata placeholder
Sync is a stub
Vision includes mock/demo paths
exit_criteria: No stable path reports mock or demo work as a real success
Demo mode is explicit and isolated
Unconfigured integrations return unavailable/setup states
Voice and vision claims use qualified real backends
Result states reach the UI unchanged

categories.name: Architecture and maintainability
evidence: backend_fastapi/main.py is approximately 2871 lines
frontend_next/app/page.js is a large client component
Overlapping implementations exist for browser, voice, UI, memory, and runtime composition
exit_criteria: Backend routers, services, repositories, and adapters are separated
Frontend state, clients, and feature components are separated
One capability registry and result contract are canonical
Storage ownership, migrations, locking, backup, and retention are explicit
Stable core passes agreed lint, type, and complexity policies

categories.name: Installation, packaging, and startup
evidence: B01 declares CPython >=3.11,<3.12 and resolves core, voice, vision, desktop, dev, and all profiles on CPython 3.11 Linux x86_64 with exact hashed locks
Validated 3.2.0 wheel and sdist contain all 190 required runtime files; package-content and Twine metadata gates pass
Exact core-lock wheel smoke passes outside the checkout for imports, CLI dispatch, package resources, backend health, clean CWD, and installed-tree immutability
There is no qualified PyPI release, Windows/macOS resolver run, one-click product install, or target-platform startup qualification
B02 still owns idempotent installation, centralized configuration/origins, and start/stop/restart qualification
exit_criteria: Every declared install profile resolves
Wheel and sdist contain intended packages
Installed-wheel smoke tests pass outside the checkout
One-click startup succeeds twice on a fresh primary machine
Configuration and origins are centralized and documented

categories.name: Security, privacy, and safe autonomy
evidence: B01 exact Python dev-lock audit reports 87 dependencies and zero known vulnerabilities at audit time
B01 npm 12 audit reports zero known vulnerabilities in the exact frontend lock
Python license inventory covers 91 expected distributions; docutils and qrcode remain review-required
API authentication is optional by default and offline behavior remains a claim rather than an enforced no-egress mode
exit_criteria: Threat model covers every stable capability
Remote access requires strong authentication
Consent cannot be bypassed by model output
Offline mode passes a no-egress test
No unaccepted critical/high runtime dependency vulnerabilities remain
Independent security review findings are closed

categories.name: Documentation and claim accuracy
evidence: README and docs index were reset during B00
B01 adds a current install/profile/lock/artifact/runtime-data troubleshooting authority and closes stale top-level packaging claims
Capability and quality status remain generated from machine-readable authorities and local Markdown links pass
Historical phase/API/architecture documents remain non-authoritative until later drift and command checks are implemented
exit_criteria: Every public claim maps to current evidence
All documented commands pass from a fresh checkout
API and capability docs are generated or drift-checked
Versions and counts are consistent
Release limitations, privacy behavior, migrations, and recovery are documented

categories.name: Personal utility and reliability
evidence: No structured 30-day daily-driver qualification has been performed
exit_criteria: Thirty consecutive dogfood days
At least 99% startup success across 100 starts
At least 95% success for every core workflow
Zero unsafe false success and zero data-loss incidents
Backup and restore are repeatedly proven
Owner keeps OMNI running for genuine value

categories.name: Commercial defensibility
evidence: OMNI Personal Core is explicitly a personal build
Public MIT code currently has no demonstrated users, revenue, retention, or proprietary distribution advantage
exit_criteria: Only score this category if a commercial track is activated
Require real adoption, retention, support, distribution, and defensibility evidence
